class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.bid=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
  self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));self.jr=self.jp.copy()
 def pose(self):
  d=self.s.data;return d.xpos[self.bid].copy(),d.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  s=self.s;m=self.m;d=self.d
  d.qpos[:]=s.data.qpos
  if q is not None:d.qpos[s._jq[:7]]=q
  for it in range(60):
   mujoco.mj_kinematics(m,d);mujoco.mj_comPos(m,d)
   e=np.r_[p-d.xpos[self.bid],Rot.from_matrix(R@d.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]
   if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-5:break
   mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,self.jp,self.jr,self.bid)
   J=np.r_[self.jp[:,s._jv[:7]],self.jr[:,s._jv[:7]]]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   dq*=min(1,.15/max(abs(dq)))
   d.qpos[s._jq[:7]]=np.clip(d.qpos[s._jq[:7]]+dq,s.lower[:7]+.001,s.upper[:7]-.001)
  return d.qpos[s._jq[:7]].copy()
 def move(self,p,R,hand=None,n=120):

  if hand is None:hand=q[7:]

  for i in range(n):

   pt=p0+(p-p0)*t;Rt=Rot.from_rotvec(dr*t).as_matrix()@R0
   q[:7]=self.ik(pt,Rt,q[:7]);q[7:]=h0+(hand-h0)*t;s.step(q)
 def hold(self,n=120):
  for _ in range(n):self.s.step(self.s.targets)
 def snap(self,name):
  s=self.s;Image.fromarray(s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png');print(name,s.steps,s.progress(),'object',s.data.xpos[s._obj],flush=True)
 def contacts(self):

   b1=self.m.geom_bodyid[co.geom1];b2=self.m.geom_bodyid[co.geom2]
   if s._obj in [b1,b2]:
    f=np.zeros(6);mujoco.mj_contactForce(self.m,s.data,list(s.data.contact).index(co),f) if False else None
    print(self.m.geom(co.geom1).name,self.m.geom(co.geom2).name,'dist',co.dist)

def handclose(f=1.,th=None):
